title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
title_zh: Search-RSI：沿多模态智能体的能力边界扩展搜索世界
abstract_en: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. In each round, the current policy diagnoses its partially mastered regions of a task space spanned by hop depth, relation rarity, and distractor density; new tasks there are grown together with their evidence; and the same policy decides how they are used: candidates on which its probes disagree feed reinforcement learning, while those beyond its reach become hint guided demonstrations of its own. Keeping the policy inside this loop matters: an improver frozen at the start of training loses 3.2 points. On nine multimodal search benchmarks, Search-RSI keeps improving where static task growth saturates, raising the average accuracy of the recipe it builds on by 9.8 and 9.5 points at 9B and 27B, of which 7.0 points are out of reach for a world that is merely made consistent. The loop uses no external model and only privileged task structure that is removed before training, at 1.27x the compute of static growth.
abstract_zh: 多模态搜索智能体依赖检索证据回答知识密集型视觉问题。现有方法从知识图谱合成多跳任务，并在训练中持续扩充任务，但检索语料保持不变：即使新问题构造合理、答案可验证，所需证据也可能不在检索库中，导致智能体发出正确查询却仍因检索失败而受罚。Search-RSI 提出一种递归自我改进框架，每轮由当前策略根据跳数、关系稀有度和干扰项密度定位尚未完全掌握的任务区域，并同步扩充任务及其可检索证据。当前策略还根据多次探测的结果分配训练样本：结果不一致的任务用于强化学习，超出当前能力的任务则用于生成带提示的自示范。在 9 项多模态搜索基准上，相比所基于的训练方案，Search-RSI 使 9B 和 27B 模型的平均准确率分别提高 9.8 和 9.5 个百分点，并在静态任务扩充趋于饱和后继续提升。整个流程不依赖外部模型，辅助任务构造的特权结构信息在训练前移除，计算开销为静态扩充的 1.27 倍。
key_points_zh: 固定检索库会不断积累证据不可达的训练样本，让智能体因语料缺失而非策略错误受到惩罚。
Search-RSI 沿跳数、关系稀有度和干扰项密度定位能力边界，同步生成新任务及其可检索证据。
探测结果不一致的任务用于强化学习，超出当前能力的任务用于生成带提示的自示范；将改进策略冻结在训练初始状态会损失 3.2 个百分点。
在 9 项基准上，9B 和 27B 模型的平均准确率分别提升 9.8 和 9.5 个百分点；仅保证任务与证据一致仍不足以获得其中 7.0 个百分点的增益。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是让视觉搜索智能体根据检索轨迹诊断能力前沿，同步扩充图像锚定任务及其可检索证据，并将候选任务分流至强化学习或自示范。受控实验中，9B 和 27B 模型较静态索引增长分别提高 10.4 和 10.2 个百分点；冻结改进策略损失 3.2 个百分点。方法约需 1.27 倍训练算力，扩展范围受源知识图谱覆盖限制。
